title: ChickenView
description: GET /view snapshot for Main / logitech. Push frames/{chicken} to displayKey (5, or 6 when focused). Idle/feed also draw houseIcon on key 4 and nestIcon on key 6.

chicken.description: PNG filename under src/chicken/frames/. Draw on displayKey.

displayKey.description: LCD key that should show chicken. 6 only when focused (in nest). 5 for every other MVP mood.

nestIcon.description: Key 6. nest_icon.png when idle/feed or chick is at the desk. Same as chicken when the chick is in the nest.

deskEmpty.description: Empty workstation (no milk). Draw on key 5 when the chick is in the nest.

houseIcon.description: Key 4. house_00.png … house_08.png (stump + wobbling egg) when idle/feed. 01_8 is held for 8 ticks. Empty string otherwise — clear the key.

houseFps.description: Advance rate for houseIcon. 8 when idle/feed; 0 when key 4 is blank. While houseFps > 0, POST tick at 1/houseFps; the chick still advances at fps.
